benchmark_command: python3 benchmarks/bench.py {self-compare --python rust-cpython/stage-quote-only/bin/python3.16 | run --baseline rust-cpython/stage-quote-only/bin/python3.16 --candidate rust-cpython/stage/bin/python3.16 --baseline-kind custom --candidate-kind custom} --suite realworld --profile standard --workload <name> --local --output <ignored-results-dir>
method: Native macOS local benchmark, serial standard profile: five alternating-order timing pairs without memory sampling, followed by three alternating-order external memory pairs. One workload process per attempt; wait4 root CPU covers all workload computation because these tasks spawn no children.
parser_cache_policy: Both parse.py caches use checked-hash invalidation, and each header hash matched its own source.
